reference.question: Calculate \(\frac{a}{a-b}+\frac{b}{b-a}\) (\(a\ne b\)). The result is
reference.solution:
Method 1: Recognize opposite denominators

\(\frac{b}{b-a}=-\frac{b}{a-b}\), so the original expression is \(\frac{a-b}{a-b}=1\).
